segments.text: First and last mile, gaano po ba?

segments.speaker: Move As One Coalition Co-convener Dr. Maureen Mata
segments.text: Kasi sobrang insufficient ang public transport natin.

segments.speaker: Move As One Coalition Co-convener Dr. Maureen Mata
segments.text: Hindi naman po kaya ng lahat na sumakay ng grab ng NETNVS.

segments.speaker: Move As One Coalition Co-convener Dr. Maureen Mata
segments.text: Ako po, pag hindi kaya ng pamasahay ko, nagmumoto-taxi po ako.

segments.speaker: Move As One Coalition Co-convener Dr. Maureen Mata
segments.text: Pero my safety is very, very araw-araw po na ang aking puso po ay kumakabog kasi hindi ko po alam baka mamatay ako.

Move As One Coalition Co-convener Dr. Maureen Mata
segments.text: Accessibility po ay precondition to inclusion.

segments.speaker: Move As One Coalition Co-convener Dr. Maureen Mata
segments.text: Kami po ay nade-discriminate, hindi po makakapag-participate on an equal basis with others kung walang aksesibilidad.

segments.speaker: Move As One Coalition Co-convener Dr. Maureen Mata
segments.text: Aksesibilidad, sabi nga po ni Dr. Elisa, ulitin ko lang, it's a universal design.

segments.speaker: Move As One Coalition Co-convener Dr. Maureen Mata
segments.text: Pag-accessible po, ang kalsada, ang pedestrian, ang sidewalk, no?

segments.speaker: Move As One Coalition Co-convener Dr. Maureen Mata
segments.text: Paglabas pa lang po ng bahay, lahat po, hindi lang po persons with disabilities ang makaka-access nito,

segments.speaker: Move As One Coalition Co-convener Dr. Maureen Mata
segments.text: kundi po buong tao sa ating pamayan.

segments.speaker: Move As One Coalition Co-convener Dr. Maureen Mata
segments.text: So, ang nire-request po namin sana para ang health services po ay maging accessible, hindi lamang po ito physical,

segments.text: hindi lamang po ito kailangan may sign language interpreter, hindi lamang po may captioner, hindi lamang po ito dapat may audio description.

segments.speaker: Move As One Coalition Co-convener Dr. Maureen Mata
segments.text: Siguraduhin din po natin ang digital accessibility is set in place for persons of different types of disabilities

segments.text: para sigurado natin hindi po talaga din sila mapag-iiwanan.

segments.speaker: Move As One Coalition Co-convener Dr. Maureen Mata
segments.text: So, budget po for safety, napakahalaga.

segments.speaker: Move As One Coalition Co-convener Dr. Maureen Mata
segments.text: At para po hindi na madagdagan yung pansanan, para hindi na po matularan na merong mount kamuning at grade crosswalks po,

segments.speaker: Move As One Coalition Co-convener Dr. Maureen Mata
segments.text: yan po yung nilalabitin namin sa Move As One Coalition.

segments.speaker: Move As One Coalition Co-convener Dr. Maureen Mata
segments.text: At siguraduhin po na may protected bike lanes po tayo para sa ating mga nagbibisikleta ay hindi po araw-araw buwis buhay ang kanilang na-experience.

segments.speaker: Move As One Coalition Co-convener Dr. Maureen Mata

segments.text: So from what you're seeing right there, actually Intramuros is the largest and extant European colonial fortification in Southeast Asia at nilalaban na po ito para mailista sa UNESCO.

segments.speaker: Renacimiento Manila Representative Bea Dolores
segments.text: Pero at nakikita natin ngayon, it's filled with plant growth.

segments.speaker: Renacimiento Manila Representative Bea Dolores
segments.text: Hindi po yan yes nature, these are actual.

segments.speaker: Renacimiento Manila Representative Bea Dolores
segments.text: Ang plants may ugat at ang ugat nakakasira po sa adobe.

segments.speaker: Renacimiento Manila Representative Bea Dolores
segments.text: At pagka nasira, magkakaroon ng structural integrity failure and kapagka nagka-earthquake, paano na?

segments.speaker: Renacimiento Manila Representative Bea Dolores
segments.text: Intramuros pa lamang po yan, ito ay kilalang site.

segments.speaker: Renacimiento Manila Representative Bea Dolores
segments.text: Napakarami pa natin mga estruktura na siguradong hindi rin napapangalagaan.

segments.speaker: Renacimiento Manila Representative Bea Dolores
segments.text: And ibig sabihin, conservation is definitely disaster risk reduction.

segments.speaker: Renacimiento Manila Representative Bea Dolores
segments.text: Kung saan, kung papondahan natin ito, baka may mas marami pa tayong masave na buhay ng tao.

segments.speaker: Renacimiento Manila Representative Bea Dolores
Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Likewise, before we continue, Intramuros is our only remaining historical artifact na talagang at least kayo pa pano.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Kasi nawasak ang Manila noon, yan lang yung naiwan.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: So we know your advocacy for promoting and for preserving our history and culture.

segments.speaker: Renacimiento Manila Representative Bea Dolores
segments.text: Actually po, ilan lamang pala ang sites na na-save noong gera?

segments.speaker: Renacimiento Manila Representative Bea Dolores
segments.text: Sa Intramuros. Mas marami pa pala. Hundreds pa outside of Intramuros. That is just within Manila.

segments.speaker: Renacimiento Manila Representative Bea Dolores
segments.text: So ibig sabihin, marami pa tayong mga hindi pinapangalagaan.

segments.speaker: Renacimiento Manila Representative Bea Dolores
segments.text: It is clear that such imposes challenges on culture and heritage, such as vulnerabilities to deterioration, disaster risk management,

segments.speaker: Renacimiento Manila Representative Bea Dolores
segments.text: inadequate maintenance and development projects that fail to sufficiently account for historical and cultural significance.

segments.speaker: Renacimiento Manila Representative Bea Dolores
Renacimiento Manila Representative Bea Dolores
segments.text: for Culture and the Arts, was only given a budget of 152 million pesos, which is 2 million pesos less than the Intramuros Administration,

segments.speaker: Renacimiento Manila Representative Bea Dolores
segments.text: despite being mandated on a national level to help support heritage sites, properties, and traditional cultural practices, including those of our IP communities.

segments.speaker: Renacimiento Manila Representative Bea Dolores
segments.text: So sa 152 million pesos na yan, kasama na dyan yung budget for grants sa pagtulong ng pag-conserve ng mga heritage structures.

segments.speaker: Renacimiento Manila Representative Bea Dolores
segments.text: Pero actually po, karamihan po sa mga, kahit isang heritage structure lang, kaabutin ka ng 200 million pesos.

segments.speaker: Renacimiento Manila Representative Bea Dolores
segments.text: Iba pa yung conservation management plan na kadalasan ay mataas sa 5 digits at around 6 digits siya most of the time.

segments.speaker: Renacimiento Manila Representative Bea Dolores
segments.text: So, anong mapapala ng 152 million pesos?

segments.speaker: Renacimiento Manila Representative Bea Dolores
segments.text: Let's be reminded that our cultural sector also deals with infrastructure.

segments.speaker: Renacimiento Manila Representative Bea Dolores
segments.text: And many are historic sites in need of professional interventions such as what I mentioned,

segments.speaker: Renacimiento Manila Representative Bea Dolores
segments.text: conservation management plans, manpower budgets, and research budgets that aid in programs for various cultural communities all over the country.

segments.speaker: Renacimiento Manila Representative Bea Dolores
segments.text: I wonder if you know already those places that are seen right there.

segments.speaker: Renacimiento Manila Representative Bea Dolores
segments.text: That manja dyan pa pala ang founding site of Katipunan, pero bakit mapanghe?

segments.speaker: Renacimiento Manila Representative Bea Dolores
Renacimiento Manila Representative Bea Dolores
Renacimiento Manila Representative Bea Dolores
segments.text: ang birthplace ni General Antonio Luna. Maglalakad ka lang mula sa Binondo Church pero malalaglag na yung historical marker niya at hindi na siya nagagamit. Magpapapicture ka na lang po sa labas. At marami pang iba. Those are just examples.

segments.speaker: Renacimiento Manila Representative Bea Dolores
segments.text: Such lack of funding represents a missed opportunity to develop existing heritage assets into productive public infrastructure that serves both cultural preservation and community development.

segments.speaker: Renacimiento Manila Representative Bea Dolores
segments.text: This is clearly evident in what Ms. Jabel has mentioned about DPWH basic infrastructure programs budget cuts for foreign-assisted public transportation projects. So, the potential of integrating public transportation with sustainable urban planning with adaptive reuse of built heritage remains unrecognized in the proposed budget allocations. So, next slide po.

segments.speaker: Renacimiento Manila Representative Bea Dolores
segments.text: This is a 3D rendering of our talented modelers. You cannot see this one anymore.

segments.speaker: Renacimiento Manila Representative Bea Dolores
Renacimiento Manila Representative Bea Dolores
Renacimiento Manila Representative Bea Dolores
segments.text: That's a part of Intramuros na katabi lamang po yan, Manila Cathedral.

segments.speaker: Renacimiento Manila Representative Bea Dolores
segments.text: At a time of hefty fork insert, our leaders should also recognize the potential existing heritage structures as an alternative or complement to new construction.

segments.speaker: Renacimiento Manila Representative Bea Dolores
segments.text: Such investments can preserve irreplaceable cultural heritage.

segments.speaker: Renacimiento Manila Representative Bea Dolores
segments.text: While creating opportunities for public services, local employment, commercial activity, tourism, and community-oriented urban renewal.

segments.speaker: Renacimiento Manila Representative Bea Dolores
segments.text: And can be concretely repurposed as museums, libraries, cultural centers, kahit nga po health center at housing.

segments.speaker: Renacimiento Manila Representative Bea Dolores
segments.text: Yung mga underutilized na structures natin, pwede pa palang magamit.

segments.speaker: Renacimiento Manila Representative Bea Dolores
segments.text: Imbes na gumawa tayo ng panibagong multipurpose building worth 100 million, 300 million.

segments.speaker: Renacimiento Manila Representative Bea Dolores
Renacimiento Manila Representative Bea Dolores
segments.text: Mas malaki pa yung mga presyo na yun kesa sa iisang pondo ng isang national cultural agency.

segments.speaker: Renacimiento Manila Representative Bea Dolores
segments.text: Tourism and heritage is the way to market our country.

segments.speaker: Renacimiento Manila Representative Bea Dolores
Renacimiento Manila Representative Bea Dolores
segments.text: Heritage conservation should therefore be considered not merely for the beautification of old buildings,

segments.speaker: Renacimiento Manila Representative Bea Dolores
segments.text: but a component of a broader public investment strategy that makes existence,

segments.speaker: Renacimiento Manila Representative Bea Dolores
segments.text: existing assets, useful, accessible, and economically productive.

segments.speaker: Renacimiento Manila Representative Bea Dolores
segments.text: Surely, proud po ang ating Senate President Will Gatchel yan sa heritage-focused successes ng Valenzuela ngayon.

segments.speaker: Renacimiento Manila Representative Bea Dolores
segments.text: Furthermore, this organization firmly believes that built heritage should be part of modern Filipino society.

segments.speaker: Renacimiento Manila Representative Bea Dolores
segments.text: This can be possible through cultural heritage tourism, adaptive reuse of heritage structure as productive public spaces,

segments.speaker: Renacimiento Manila Representative Bea Dolores
segments.text: investments can stimulate local economies, create livelihoods, and attract continued economic activity,

segments.speaker: Renacimiento Manila Representative Bea Dolores
segments.text: lalo na ngayon na ang baba ng US dollar rate natin.

segments.speaker: Renacimiento Manila Representative Bea Dolores
segments.text: So baka naman tumaas-taas ang value ng peso kapag ka mas magrabing bongga ang ating funding for our heritage.

segments.speaker: Renacimiento Manila Representative Bea Dolores
segments.text: With sustained budgetary support, these benefits can extend beyond immediate tourism revenues to deliver long-term returns.

segments.speaker: Renacimiento Manila Representative Bea Dolores
segments.text: Making heritage conservation a strategic investment in inclusive economic development rather than a discretionary expenditure.

segments.speaker: Renacimiento Manila Representative Bea Dolores
segments.text: So ito po ang short-term interventions na baka po pwede pong mabigyang focus ng ating butihing mga senador.

segments.speaker: Renacimiento Manila Representative Bea Dolores
segments.text: Una sa lahat, i-review at i-scrutinize ang over P541 billion peso BARSc pork funds with multi-purpose buildings worth P42.7 billion.

segments.speaker: Renacimiento Manila Representative Bea Dolores
segments.text: And reallocate back to foreign-assistant projects, El Nino, DRRM, Healthcare and Heritage.

segments.speaker: Renacimiento Manila Representative Bea Dolores
segments.text: Also, scrutinize national expenditure program to H-GAB Third Reading Fund jumps with 2,805 potential insertion candidates

segments.speaker: Renacimiento Manila Representative Bea Dolores
segments.text: with numerous multi-purpose building projects individually worth P100 million to P500 million

segments.speaker: Renacimiento Manila Representative Bea Dolores
segments.text: despite cultural agencies only receiving P150 million for 2027.

segments.speaker: Renacimiento Manila Representative Bea Dolores
segments.text: And lastly, kung kayang maka-afford na magpondo ng multi-purpose buildings na yan individually na P100 million, P300 million, P400 million, P500 million,

segments.speaker: Renacimiento Manila Representative Bea Dolores
segments.text: sigurado namang pwede nating mataasan ang pondo ng cultural agencies natin, most especially nasa NCCA.

segments.speaker: Renacimiento Manila Representative Bea Dolores
Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Thank you for your advocacy to preserve heritage and culture.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Ako na sa San Juan, where, of course, it's a small city, it's a small town.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: That time when I became mayor pa yun, yung historical significance, that's why nag-ano kami yung Museo na Katipunan,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: that was my project na, syempre, dedicated to our katipuneros.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Tapos yung mga nilagay ko yung bandayog nila, Andres Bonifacio, Mio Sindo for our youth.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Na ano pa nga ako noon eh.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Sabi eh, yung mga pinapatayo ko, iputan lang daw ng ibon.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Alam mo, the sad reality, kaya walang masyadong may gusto sa history na mga public official, wala kasing boto dyan eh.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Kailangan lang, mahal mo talaga yung bayan mo, yung culture and history for you to really appreciate and preserve.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: But thank you for your advocacy.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Syempre, meron, di naman talaga ano, importante talaga yan.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Thank you very much for that.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Last but not the least, Pablo.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Public Services Labor Independent Confederation or PSLINK, Dr. Annie Enriquez-Geron.

segments.speaker: PSLINK President Dr. Annie Enriquez-Geron
PSLINK President Dr. Annie Enriquez-Geron
segments.text: Ako po lang ang namamagitan sa uwian.

segments.speaker: PSLINK President Dr. Annie Enriquez-Geron
PSLINK President Dr. Annie Enriquez-Geron
segments.text: Ako po si Annie Geron, Pangulo po ng PSLINK Public.

segments.speaker: PSLINK President Dr. Annie Enriquez-Geron
segments.text: At ang kinakatawan ko po dito ay Organisadong Hanay ng mga kawani ng pamahalaan.

segments.speaker: PSLINK President Dr. Annie Enriquez-Geron
segments.text: Ibig sabihin kami po yung union sa sektor publiko.

segments.speaker: PSLINK President Dr. Annie Enriquez-Geron
segments.text: At mula po 2007, kami po ay aktibong bahagi ng Alternative Budget Initiative ng Social Watch Philippines.

segments.speaker: PSLINK President Dr. Annie Enriquez-Geron
segments.text: Na talaga pong tumitingin dito sa mga budget.

segments.speaker: PSLINK President Dr. Annie Enriquez-Geron
segments.text: Ang aming pong pinakamatagal na layunin ay yung dekalidad na serbisyo publiko sa ilalim ng isang pamahalang bukas, tapat at may pananagutan.

segments.speaker: PSLINK President Dr. Annie Enriquez-Geron
segments.text: Narinig natin kanina yung lahat ng sinasabi.

segments.speaker: PSLINK President Dr. Annie Enriquez-Geron
segments.text: Pero gusto ko pong sabihin, Senator Lacson and Senator JB, sa pagkakataong ito, ang hirap maging kawani ng pamahalaan.

segments.speaker: PSLINK President Dr. Annie Enriquez-Geron
segments.text: Kanina, nabanggit po ninyo, kailangan ibalik natin ang tiwala ng bayan sa pamahalaan, sa mga opisyal at sa mga kawani.

segments.speaker: PSLINK President Dr. Annie Enriquez-Geron
PSLINK President Dr. Annie Enriquez-Geron
segments.text: Dinurog ng korupsyon yung tiwala ng bayan sa pamahalaan.

segments.speaker: PSLINK President Dr. Annie Enriquez-Geron
segments.text: At kailangan po natin ng dagliang ebidensya o resibo ng ating paglaban sa korupsyon.

segments.speaker: PSLINK President Dr. Annie Enriquez-Geron
segments.text: Katulad ng kailangan makita ng taong bayan na mayroon talagang nananagot at managot dito sa katiwalian.

segments.speaker: PSLINK President Dr. Annie Enriquez-Geron
segments.text: Yung mga nagsamantala, yung mga nagmalabis, yung hindi tubig ng bahay.

segments.speaker: PSLINK President Dr. Annie Enriquez-Geron
segments.text: Yung mga nagsamantala ang nilimas kung hindi nilimas yung pondo ng bayan, yun po kailangan talaga makita natin na makulong, managot.

segments.speaker: PSLINK President Dr. Annie Enriquez-Geron
segments.text: Hindi yung nagkakaroon pa ng espasyo para ipaliwanag at ikatwiran na marami naman daw sila magnanakaw bakit sila lang ang tinitira.

segments.speaker: PSLINK President Dr. Annie Enriquez-Geron
segments.text: So alam ni Senator Ping Lacson kung sino yung tinutukoy ko.

segments.speaker: PSLINK President Dr. Annie Enriquez-Geron
PSLINK President Dr. Annie Enriquez-Geron
segments.text: Pero ano po yung isa pang dahilan kung bakit mahirap na kawani ng pamahalaan?

segments.speaker: PSLINK President Dr. Annie Enriquez-Geron
segments.text: Kasi po, alam niyo na yung mga kawani ang nasa bukana ng paghatid ng serbisyo publiko.

segments.speaker: PSLINK President Dr. Annie Enriquez-Geron
segments.text: Pero mahirap po sapagkat kung kulang ang pondo, kulang ang kagamitan mo, kulang ang bilang ng mga kawani para doon sa mga paghatid ng serbisyo publiko.

segments.speaker: PSLINK President Dr. Annie Enriquez-Geron
segments.text: So bumaba ba po rin yung kalidad?

segments.speaker: PSLINK President Dr. Annie Enriquez-Geron
segments.text: At dahil nga po sa korupsyon, pag humaharap ka sa komunidad at kulang yung gamit mo, pagdududahan ka eh.

segments.speaker: PSLINK President Dr. Annie Enriquez-Geron
segments.text: Eh siguro kaya kulang binulusan nyo na. O kaya kayo na ang nauna.

segments.speaker: PSLINK President Dr. Annie Enriquez-Geron
segments.text: Ang isa pa pong hamon dito ay syempre sa punto de vista ng manggagawa, eh isang milyon na po ang kontraktwal sa sektor publiko.

segments.speaker: PSLINK President Dr. Annie Enriquez-Geron
segments.text: Mas marami pa po sila kaysa sa mga plantilya.

segments.speaker: PSLINK President Dr. Annie Enriquez-Geron
PSLINK President Dr. Annie Enriquez-Geron
segments.text: Hindi sigurado ang kanilang trabaho at hindi nila alam kung bukas makalawa ay wala na silang trabaho.

segments.speaker: PSLINK President Dr. Annie Enriquez-Geron
segments.text: Kaya meron din pong epekto yan sa commitment doon sa pagsisikap ng mga tao sa paghatid ng serbisyo publiko.

segments.speaker: PSLINK President Dr. Annie Enriquez-Geron
segments.text: Babalikan ko lang po yung kaninang pinresent kasi magpapartikular po ako sa health, sa pangkalusugan.

segments.speaker: PSLINK President Dr. Annie Enriquez-Geron
segments.text: Sapagkat yan po yung sa akin pangunahing karapang-tampang tao yan eh.

segments.speaker: PSLINK President Dr. Annie Enriquez-Geron
segments.text: Hindi mo pwedeng na-enjoy yung right to education, right to work, right to life kung wala ho tayong mabuting kalusugan.

segments.speaker: PSLINK President Dr. Annie Enriquez-Geron
segments.text: So sinabi po ni Dr. JP kanina na 250 billion taon-taon ang nakakalap mula sa direct contributors.

segments.speaker: PSLINK President Dr. Annie Enriquez-Geron
segments.text: Marami po dyan ang kontribusyon ng manggagawa.

segments.speaker: PSLINK President Dr. Annie Enriquez-Geron
segments.text: Hindi pa nahawakan ng sweldong kakarimpot, paltas na ang sa PhilHealth.

segments.speaker: PSLINK President Dr. Annie Enriquez-Geron
PSLINK President Dr. Annie Enriquez-Geron
segments.text: Hindi para lamang yan sa mga manggagawa kung hindi ito ay nagagamit para din po doon sa mga hindi kayang mag-contribute.

segments.speaker: PSLINK President Dr. Annie Enriquez-Geron
segments.text: Pero yung sinasabi ko po, Sen. Ping, Sen. JP, huwag naman talikuran ng gobyerno yung obligasyon niya at ipapasa.

segments.speaker: PSLINK President Dr. Annie Enriquez-Geron
segments.text: Dahil hindi niya po ponduhan ng maayos, hindi niya ibibigay yung share ng PhilHealth, ang [unclear], sa sin tax, sa PAGCOR, sa PCSO.

segments.speaker: PSLINK President Dr. Annie Enriquez-Geron
segments.text: Lumalabas po noon yung direct contributors.

segments.speaker: PSLINK President Dr. Annie Enriquez-Geron
segments.text: Ang bumabalikat para doon sa mga indigent at non-contributors o indirect contributors.

segments.speaker: PSLINK President Dr. Annie Enriquez-Geron
segments.text: So sana makita po natin na hindi naman ito dapat.

segments.speaker: PSLINK President Dr. Annie Enriquez-Geron
segments.text: Sabi nga kanina, ay nasa batas yan eh. Bakit hindi sumunod ang pamahalaan sa batas?

segments.speaker: PSLINK President Dr. Annie Enriquez-Geron
segments.text: Paano ka magpapatupad ng batas sa iba, sa pribadong sektor, kung ikaw mismo hindi ka sumusunod sa batas?

segments.speaker: PSLINK President Dr. Annie Enriquez-Geron
segments.text: So yun po yung talagang mahirap po.

segments.speaker: PSLINK President Dr. Annie Enriquez-Geron
segments.text: Kasi yung mga government employee, kaya nasa Senate, sa House, sa Judicatura, sa Executive, kami po yung gulugod ng servisyo publiko eh.

segments.text: or sa isang fund na lang siya.

segments.speaker: Healthcare Professional Alliance Representative Dr. Albert Ong

segments.text: or by having MAIFIP or other financial assistance funding,

segments.speaker: Healthcare Professional Alliance Representative Dr. Albert Ong
segments.text: parang nade-defeat yung purpose, yung original purpose po doon sa UHC Act

segments.speaker: Healthcare Professional Alliance Representative Dr. Albert Ong
segments.text: na i-consolidate lahat ng funding sa isang single-payer system

segments.speaker: Healthcare Professional Alliance Representative Dr. Albert Ong
segments.text: kasi based on the concepts of health financing and based on sa mga studies,

segments.speaker: Healthcare Professional Alliance Representative Dr. Albert Ong
segments.text: pag may single-payer health system po tayo, mas nakaka-negotiate tayo doon sa prices,

segments.speaker: Healthcare Professional Alliance Representative Dr. Albert Ong
segments.text: mas napapababa yung cost of health, yun yung vision po,

segments.speaker: Healthcare Professional Alliance Representative Dr. Albert Ong
segments.text: mas nakaka-negotiate yung government to lower the cost of health services po.

segments.speaker: Healthcare Professional Alliance Representative Dr. Albert Ong
segments.text: So, kaya po, yes po, maganda yung purpose ng financial assistance

segments.speaker: Healthcare Professional Alliance Representative Dr. Albert Ong
segments.text: and we admit po na yun po yung napupuntahan,

segments.speaker: Healthcare Professional Alliance Representative Dr. Albert Ong
segments.text: yun yung alam ng mga tao napupuntahan kapag kailangan nila ng financial assistance

segments.speaker: Healthcare Professional Alliance Representative Dr. Albert Ong
segments.text: but we in the national government and in the policy development,

segments.speaker: Healthcare Professional Alliance Representative Dr. Albert Ong
segments.text: alam ko po na alam natin na,

segments.speaker: Healthcare Professional Alliance Representative Dr. Albert Ong

segments.text: nagiging fragmented yung financing for healthcare,

segments.speaker: Healthcare Professional Alliance Representative Dr. Albert Ong
segments.text: mas mapapababa natin yung cost of health services

segments.speaker: Healthcare Professional Alliance Representative Dr. Albert Ong
segments.text: if we have a single-payer health system po.

segments.speaker: Filipino Sign Language National Network Convenor Dr. Liza B. Martinez
segments.text: Mr. Chair, maikli lang po hindi na ito aabot for 2027 pero something to think about, number one, is to study the concept of a social protection floor dahil nga the question of all the ayuda.

segments.speaker: Filipino Sign Language National Network Convenor Dr. Liza B. Martinez
segments.text: And second, hindi ko po alam baka inaral na, what is the taxation structure for the electronic or online gaming?

segments.speaker: Filipino Sign Language National Network Convenor Dr. Liza B. Martinez
segments.text: Yung domestic kasi wala na yung POGOs pero yung, kasi ang laki po talaga ng perang nandyan.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Yeah, well, I intend to file a resolution to investigate kasi alam niyo yung POGO nun, kung wala lang sana yung crime na related to it,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: at is yung pera ng INJIC pumapasok dito. Itong PIGO, pera ng Pilipino.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: So, we're studying already kasi laki daw ng billions na nawawala.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Na sana consumer-driven tayo, nagagamit si ekonomiya natin, lumalabas pa.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: So, we'll take note of that. Thank you po, ma'am.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Tapos siguro before we end, be rest assured that as chair of the committee on finance,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: we will restore the budget cuts.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Andito si Senator Lacson, tutulungan ako nito.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Metro Manila Subway Project, yun po yung para sa foreign-assisted.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Tapos 15 billion for the North-South Commuter Railway Project.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: We will also look into the main bridges, yung Bataan, Cavite, Link, yung Laguna, Coastal Highway, and other major legacy projects.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: So, yung pong commitment, itutuloy talaga natin.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Because this will really, yan ang kailangan talaga natin, this infrastructure.

People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: Just on the local government support fund, Chair JV.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: Actually, maganda po siguro yung i-distinguish yung ibang components

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: Because there are three major funds under the LGSF.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: Under the HGAB, around 62 billion na siya.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: Meron pong financial assistance to LGUs.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: Actually, yun po yung pinag-uusapan natin kanina, 41.5 billion.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: There's also a second category called the growth equity fund.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: This is supposed to change the inequitable allocations

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: Although we know that at the longer term,

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: yung kailangan po talaga natin ay a change in the way that NTA is computed.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: Which I think there are pending bills also pushed by Local Gov PH,

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: And then, third po, si NTF-ELCAC support to barangay is 9.7 billion.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: Which we're all saying we should abolish it and just remove the funding for that.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: So that we can increase funding for

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: for the improvement in the equity in the changes.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: So ngayon naman po, sa financial assistance to LGUs in particular,

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: yung iba pong mga iniisip namin na designs include a matching fund.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: Kasi for example, dapat po merong nationally mandated programs

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: such as for example, malnutrition programs na pwedeng nakailangan,

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: na priorities talaga for early childhood.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: At 1,000 days, the local government units will only get the fund

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: if they provide counterpart funding para doble yung financial assistance.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: We can also do the same for mobility, for local transport and mobility offices.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: So maybe we can think of a special provision and we can design something together as NJV

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: na maging policy-based yung financial assistance to LGUs at hindi siya magbukang pork barrel.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Senator Laxon was saying that if you can provide us yung inyong study about this.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Sa itong LGSF, I think we can improve it para at least maging effective siya.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Kasi we still believe that infrastructure, especially the look, can stimulate.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Makakatulong sa economy yan, multiplier effect yan.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Pero yun lang, dapat equitable lalo na sa maganda yun, third to fifth class.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: At least maging makatulong naman doon sa mga talagang nangangailangan

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: tsaka yung poorer municipalities na kailangan ng tulong.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Kasi minsan nakakalot, masakit sa loob.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Minsan nakikita mo na mayayaman ng distrito, mayayaman ng LGU.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Dahil wala na magpaglagyan, sisirain yung gawa, gagawin.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: So at least, if you can provide us yung inyong recommendation

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: so that we can maging effective itong LGSF para hindi na maging merong pinapaboran.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: We will, ano, sa aming committee amendment.

segments.speaker: Senator Panfilo "Ping" M. Lacson
Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Sige yun, di ba ikam na.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
E-Net Philippines National Executive Board Member Prof. Flora C. Arellano
E-Net Philippines National Executive Board Member Prof. Flora C. Arellano
segments.text: Sir, huwag nyo naman kalimutan yung aming sinabmit na budget proposals
